rows.description: A young professional notices elders resisting even small changes at home and at work. Respecting the fear behind it and trying a small pilot works better than pushing.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A wise decider asks which option she would choose if none were the default, and tests one small change to see whether the feared cost truly appears.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A child feels happy when told he got 8 of 10 right and sad when told he got 2 wrong. Identical facts feel different depending on how they are put.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A teenager reacts strongly to being called a 40 percent failure rather than 60 percent successful. The wording swings his mood and his choices.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A student is drawn to an offer described as 90 percent lean or 20 percent off yet is put off by the same figures phrased as a loss. Ads use this constantly.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.description: A mature person restates a choice both as gain and as loss, and in absolute numbers, before deciding, and frames things fairly for others rather than to steer them.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A child assumes the tall, cheerful classmate is also smart and honest. One good trait spreads into a general glow.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A teenager believes whatever a talented or good-looking influencer says about health or money, because admiration in one area carries over to everything.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A peer sees an interviewer rate a charming candidate high across every skill. Scoring each skill separately weakens the halo.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.description: A fair reviewer separates each trait, such as reliability and communication, and asks for examples before rating, so a strong star does not lift everything unearned.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22
